lines.zh: 我踩过潮湿菌毯，盔甲咯吱作响。
lines.en: My armor creaks as I cross the wet spore carpet.

lines.zh: 我在走廊里踱步，像守着空王座。
lines.en: I pace the corridor like a guard at an empty throne.

lines.zh: 每走一步，肩甲上的孢子就落一层。
lines.en: Each step shakes another layer of spores off my pauldrons.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，铁靴里长满了菌丝。
lines.en: I walk slowly, hyphae filling both my iron boots.

lines.zh: 巡逻没有尽头，这条走廊也没有出口。
lines.en: The patrol never ends, and this corridor has no exit.

lines.zh: 我拖着剑走，剑尖在石头上划出白痕。
lines.en: I drag my blade, leaving white scratches on the stone.

lines.zh: 我在菌光下走，影子比人还高。
lines.en: I walk under the fungal glow, my shadow taller than I am.

lines.zh: 破损的护膝磨着石头，一路作响。
lines.en: My cracked knee guard grinds against the stone as I march.

lines.zh: 我沿着菌染村庄的边界绕圈。
lines.en: I circle the border of the infected village.

lines.zh: 风把我的披风扯起，露出下面的菌斑。
lines.en: Wind lifts my cloak and shows the spores beneath.

lines.zh: 我从一具旧盔甲旁走过，没有低头。
lines.en: I pass an old suit of armor without lowering my gaze.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但没有一步是后退。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, but not one step goes backward.

lines.zh: 我站着，把剑立在脚边。
lines.en: I stand with my sword planted at my feet.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我颈侧探出，慢慢缠紧。
lines.en: Hyphae creep from my neck and slowly tighten.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的呼吸，一次比一次慢。
lines.en: I count my breaths, each slower than the last.

lines.zh: 我擦掉护甲上的孢子，很快又落满。
lines.en: I wipe spores from my armor; they settle again at once.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会再来的号令。
lines.en: I wait for an order that will never come again.

lines.zh: 静止时我能听见盔甲里的菌在长。
lines.en: At rest I hear the fungus growing inside my armor.

lines.zh: 我把断剑插回鞘，鞘早已烂了。
lines.en: I sheathe my broken sword in a scabbard long rotted.

lines.zh: 王座空了，我的岗还没有撤。
lines.en: The throne stands empty; my post is not relieved.

lines.zh: 我低头看胸口，那里透出微弱的菌光。
lines.en: I look down; faint fungal light shows through my chest.

lines.zh: 我保持站姿，怕一坐下就散架。
lines.en: I hold my stance, afraid sitting would make me fall apart.

lines.zh: 空闲时我把手指一根根掰直。
lines.en: In the quiet I straighten my fingers one by one.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的嘶鸣，没有回应。
lines.en: I hear distant shrieks and give no answer.

lines.zh: 我对着水洼整理头盔，里面没有脸。
lines.en: I straighten my helm before a puddle; no face inside.

lines.zh: 我在两堵墙之间站了很久，像根柱子。
lines.en: I stand between two walls a long while, like a pillar.

lines.zh: 我试着行礼，腰没有弯下来。
lines.en: I try to bow, and my waist will not bend.

lines.zh: 甲片下面，菌丝正把骨缝填满。
lines.en: Under the plates, hyphae fill the seams of bone.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，孢子跟着我的手走。
lines.en: I lift a hand, and the spores follow it.

lines.zh: 旗帜早烂了，我还举着杆。
lines.en: The banner rotted long ago; I still hold the pole.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹲下，又站回原位。
lines.en: I crouch slowly, then stand back where I was.

lines.zh: 水洼照不出我，只照出菌群。
lines.en: The puddle shows no me, only the colony.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，先看你的剑，再看你的眼。
lines.en: I look up, first at your sword, then your eyes.

lines.zh: 你走得越近，我盔甲上的菌光越亮。
lines.en: The closer you come, the brighter the spores on my armor.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，判断你会不会拔剑。
lines.en: I watch your hands, judging whether you will draw.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，颈甲里掉出干菌。
lines.en: I tilt my head; dry fungus falls from my gorget.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌斑，这让我警觉。
lines.en: You carry no spore marks, and that puts me on guard.

lines.zh: 我看着你的靴子，估算你还能退几步。
lines.en: I study your boots, reckoning how many steps you can retreat.

lines.zh: 我隔着面甲看你，呼吸把铁片吹响。
lines.en: I watch through my visor, breath whistling in the iron.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我的影子缩了一下。
lines.en: You raise your torch; my shadow shrinks a little.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的脸，也记住了你的甲。
lines.en: I memorize your face, and the armor you wear.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你腰间的药瓶上。
lines.en: My gaze settles on the potion at your belt.

lines.zh: 你不挪脚，我的剑也停在半空。
lines.en: You do not shift your feet, so my sword hangs midair.

lines.zh: 我看出你累了，护甲却让我不能急。
lines.en: I see you are tired, but my armor will not let me hurry.

lines.zh: 甲片凹了，我把它按回去。
lines.en: The plate dents; I press it back into shape.

lines.zh: 我流出的不是血，是一层菌浆。
lines.en: What leaks from me is not blood but spore paste.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，只是来得越来越慢。
lines.en: There is pain, only it arrives more and more slowly.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，像盔甲自己在响。
lines.en: I grunt, and it sounds like the armor creaking.

lines.zh: 伤口里钻出细丝，自己把口子缝上。
lines.en: Threads poke from the wound and stitch it shut.

lines.zh: 你砍得不错，我的甲替你记下了。
lines.en: Good cut; my armor will remember it for you.

lines.zh: 我退半步，血少了，甲就厚一分。
lines.en: I fall back half a step; less blood means thicker plate.

lines.zh: 我按住肋下，那里早就是空的了。
lines.en: I press my ribs, hollow for a long time now.

lines.zh: 骨头断的声，比剑碰铁更闷。
lines.en: A bone snapping sounds duller than steel on steel.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，先数掉了几颗心。
lines.en: I look at the wound and count the hearts I have lost.

lines.zh: 那碗蘑菇煲的味道，我记得。
lines.en: I remember the smell of that mushroom stew.

lines.zh: 你手里的腐肉，让我喉咙发紧。
lines.en: The rotten flesh in your hand tightens my throat.

lines.zh: 我闻到了菌汤，脚步自己往前。
lines.en: I smell fungal soup and my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 别晃那袋菌光孢子，我会跟过去。
lines.en: Do not wave that pouch of glowing spores; I will follow.

lines.zh: 我把剑垂下来，只想要一口。
lines.en: I lower my blade and only want one bite.

lines.zh: 饥饿比号令更响，这很丢人。
lines.en: Hunger is louder than orders, and that shames me.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就再往前半步。
lines.en: You step back, and I shuffle half a step forward.

lines.zh: 我盯着那碗炖菜，面甲里在滴水。
lines.en: I stare at the stew, water dripping inside my visor.

lines.zh: 给我半块面包，我可以晚点动手。
lines.en: Give me half a loaf and I may strike later.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，又想起自己已经不会吃了。
lines.en: I reach out, then recall I can no longer eat.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩甲，像撞一堵湿墙。
lines.en: You hit my pauldron like a damp wall.

lines.zh: 我的护甲咯吱一响，没有退。
lines.en: My armor creaks once, and I do not give ground.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，菌丝会爬上你的袖子。
lines.en: Do not press so close; hyphae will climb your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，掉下一地干孢子。
lines.en: We collide, and dry spores rain to the floor.

lines.zh: 我的重量比你多一副铁壳。
lines.en: I carry a full iron shell more than you do.

lines.zh: 你推我，我只晃了半寸。
lines.en: You shove me; I sway half an inch.

lines.zh: 铁与铁擦出火星，菌在火星里缩了。
lines.en: Iron scrapes iron; sparks fly and the fungus recoils.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，肩甲还是蹭到了你。
lines.en: I turn to let you pass, yet my pauldron still grazes you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚甲，我听见骨头的响。
lines.en: You step on my sabaton and I hear bone creak.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我站回原位，像没动过。
lines.en: After the bump I return to my place as if unmoved.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，谁也没有先开口。
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder, neither speaking first.

lines.zh: 两只菌骑士之间，孢子会自己交换。
lines.en: Between two knights, spores exchange without a word.

lines.zh: 我敲了敲胸甲，那是我们的招呼。
lines.en: I knock on my breastplate; that is how we greet.

lines.zh: 我们背对背，把走廊守成一条线。
lines.en: Back to back, we hold the corridor as one line.

lines.zh: 同袍的剑钝了，我替他把刃磨直。
lines.en: My comrade's blade is dull; I grind it straight for him.

lines.zh: 我们不争食，菌会替我们分。
lines.en: We do not fight over food; the fungus divides it for us.

lines.zh: 我认得出他的菌斑，像认一枚徽记。
lines.en: I know his spore pattern as I know a crest.

lines.zh: 谁倒下，另一个就替他站到天亮。
lines.en: If one falls, the other stands his watch till dawn.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一次呼吸，然后各自散开。
lines.en: We trade one breath, then part ways.

lines.zh: 队列只剩我们两个，队形还算整齐。
lines.en: Only two of us remain, and the formation still holds.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起断刃，指缝里挤出菌水。
lines.en: I stoop for a broken blade; spore water seeps between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚旧徽章，擦净，别回胸口。
lines.en: I pick up an old badge, wipe it, and pin it back.

lines.zh: 地上那把剑归我，它比我手里这把好。
lines.en: That sword on the ground is mine; it beats the one I hold.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指夹起骨头，扔到一边。
lines.en: I lift a bone between two fingers and toss it aside.

lines.zh: 拾取时我的膝盖响得像旧门轴。
lines.en: As I pick things up my knees sound like old hinges.

lines.zh: 我把盾牌拖起来，边缘已经烂了一半。
lines.en: I drag up a shield whose rim has half rotted away.

lines.zh: 那些散落的铁片，我都收进腰袋。
lines.en: I gather the scattered iron scraps into my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的箭，折成两段。
lines.en: I pick up your arrow and snap it in two.

lines.zh: 菌丝帮我把东西缠住，倒省了手。
lines.en: Hyphae hold what I gather, sparing my hands the work.

lines.zh: 我拿起头盔试了试，尺寸不合。
lines.en: I try on a helmet; it does not fit.

lines.zh: 你踏进岗哨线，我的剑就抬起来了。
lines.en: You cross the sentry line, and my sword comes up.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的活人味，目标锁定。
lines.en: I catch the smell of living flesh; target fixed.

lines.zh: 面甲里的菌光变红，我认下了你。
lines.en: The glow in my visor turns red; I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 你穿的那身皮甲，挡不住我的第一下。
lines.en: That leather of yours will not stop my first blow.

lines.zh: 我把剑尖指向你，这是正式的通知。
lines.en: I level my blade at you; consider this formal notice.

lines.zh: 你退到第九步，我就开始走。
lines.en: When you reach the ninth step back, I start walking.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，比号角更清楚。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, clearer than any horn.

lines.zh: 你在我的守区里，这就算宣战。
lines.en: You stand inside my watch; that counts as a declaration.

lines.zh: 我记下你的位置，之后不会跟丢。
lines.en: I mark where you stand and will not lose you.

lines.zh: 菌丝顺着我的手臂收紧，准备开战。
lines.en: Hyphae tighten along my arm, ready for the fight.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕过菌柱，一步也没慢。
lines.en: I follow you around the fungal pillar without slowing.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的剑尖也跟着换。
lines.en: You change direction; my blade tip follows.

lines.zh: 我不喊，只把脚步压得更沉。
lines.en: I do not shout; I only make my steps heavier.

lines.zh: 你跳上矮墙，我就在墙下等着。
lines.en: You leap onto a low wall; I wait below it.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步频，慢慢缩短距离。
lines.en: I count your stride and close the gap little by little.

lines.zh: 你把火把扔过来，我偏头躲开。
lines.en: You throw a torch; I turn my head aside.

lines.zh: 我走直线，你绕弯，那也没用。
lines.en: I walk straight while you curve, and it will not help.

lines.zh: 我的护甲重，可我不会先喘。
lines.en: My armor is heavy, but I will not tire first.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我停在树前等你出来。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I wait in front of it.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在你刚才的脚印上。
lines.en: Every step of mine lands in your last footprint.

lines.zh: 我这一剑劈下来，铁锈和菌一起飞。
lines.en: My blade comes down, rust and spores flying together.

lines.zh: 剑卡进你的盾里，我就用肩甲撞。
lines.en: The blade sticks in your shield, so I drive a pauldron in.

lines.zh: 我横斩，菌光在刃口拉出一条线。
lines.en: I slash sideways; spore light trails the edge.

lines.zh: 你不退，那我就再补一下。
lines.en: You do not retreat, so I add another blow.

lines.zh: 剑太重，我干脆用剑柄砸。
lines.en: The sword is too heavy; I strike with the pommel instead.

lines.zh: 我砍中你的手臂，听见甲片裂开。
lines.en: I catch your arm and hear the plate split.

lines.zh: 每挥一次，肩上的孢子就炸开一团。
lines.en: Each swing bursts another cloud of spores from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我劈向你膝盖，那里甲最薄。
lines.en: I cut at your knee, where the armor is thinnest.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，我的虎口也裂了。
lines.en: You block it, and my own hand splits open.

lines.zh: 收剑的时候，我的胳膊在发抖。
lines.en: As I draw back, my arm is shaking.

lines.zh: 我从一具村民的尸身上撑起来。
lines.en: I push myself up from a villager's corpse.

lines.zh: 菌丝把我拼成人形，然后塞进盔甲。
lines.en: Hyphae assemble me into a man, then stuff me into armor.

lines.zh: 二十二点五成的机会，我算是成了。
lines.en: Twenty-two and a half percent; I count as a success.

lines.zh: 我从菌毯下爬出，先摸到一把剑。
lines.en: I crawl from the spore mat and find a sword first.

lines.zh: 记忆只剩半截，甲却穿得整整齐齐。
lines.en: My memory is half gone, yet my armor sits neat.

lines.zh: 我在废弃的岗亭里睁眼，天刚黑。
lines.en: I open my eyes in an abandoned post at nightfall.

lines.zh: 盔甲是死人留下的，我正好合身。
lines.en: The armor came from a dead man, and it fits me.

lines.zh: 我的手先长出骨头，再长出手套。
lines.en: Bone grows in my hand before the gauntlet does.

lines.zh: 我从菌染的村庄站起来，路还认得。
lines.en: I rise in an infected village and still know the roads.

lines.zh: 胸腔里那点菌火一亮，我就开始巡逻。
lines.en: A spark of fungal fire in my chest, and I begin patrol.

lines.zh: 我捡起第一把剑时，剑柄还是热的。
lines.en: The hilt was still warm when I picked up my first sword.

lines.zh: 我醒来第一件事，是找一面镜子。
lines.en: The first thing I did on waking was look for a mirror.

lines.zh: 火苗沿着菌丝往上爬，我闻到自己烧焦。
lines.en: Flame climbs my hyphae; I smell myself burning.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，甲响了一路。
lines.en: I roll down the steps, armor clattering the whole way.

lines.zh: 水灌进面甲，菌在里面浮起来。
lines.en: Water floods my visor and the fungus floats inside.

lines.zh: 爆风掀翻我，胸甲碎成七八片。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and cracks my breastplate into pieces.

lines.zh: 箭卡在胸甲缝里，我懒得拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my breastplate seam; I leave it.

lines.zh: 那股药水味钻进骨头，我的菌缩了。
lines.en: That potion tang soaks into bone; my spores shrink.

lines.zh: 饿到骨头里，菌开始吃我自己。
lines.en: Hunger reaches my bones, and the fungus eats me.

lines.zh: 雷落在剑尖上，我的手臂全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my blade tip and numbs my whole arm.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我的甲还在往下坠。
lines.en: No ground beneath me, and my armor keeps falling.
